section.para: In this lesson, you will find and interpret the correlation coefficient and use it to understand the strength of a linear relationship.
When you finish this lesson, you will be able to:

list.item: Describe the “goodness of fit” of a linear model using the correlation coefficient.
Match the correlation coefficient with a scatter plot and linear model.
